description: Elemental Tower Defense - A lightweight browser game built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features fire, ice, lightning towers, continuous waves, and sound effects!
readme:
---

🔮 About The Game 🔮


** Elemental Tower Defence ** is a fast-paced, real-time strategic tower defense game engineered natively on HTML5 Canvas. Harness the raw power of primordial elements—**Fire, Water, Earth, and Lightning**—to construct an impenetrable defensive line. Strategically place specialized elemental towers, upgrade their destructive capabilities, and neutralize escalating waves of cunning enemies before they breach your kingdom's sanctuary.
---

⚡ Key Features ⚡


- ⚡ Elemental Synergies & Types: Deploy unique towers with distinct attack ranges, damage types, and elemental effects. - 🌊 Escalating Enemy Waves: Face increasingly challenging waves of enemies with varying speeds, health pools, and resistances. - 🎯 Tactical Upgrades & Economy: Manage gold resources to build, upgrade, and strategically position your defenses. - 🎨 HTML5 Canvas Graphics: Smooth, 60 FPS real-time rendering with neon visual effects and projectile physics. - 🚀 Instant Browser Play: Lightweight, zero dependencies, and immediately playable across all modern desktop browsers.
---

🚀 Quick Play (Local Setup) 🚀


1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/vidushisen/Elemental-Tower-Defence.git 2. Enter the project directory cd Elemental-Tower-Defence 3. Open index.html in any modern browser!
